outcome.answer: For on-policy distillation, StableOPD targets repetition-driven length inflation with a reference-based divergence constraint and rollout-mixture distillation [1]. Another approach treats functionally equivalent EOS tokens as a shared stopping action, mitigating inflation caused by student–teacher termination mismatch, though it does not eliminate all late-training inflation [2]. For shorter reasoning traces, BIRD first trains on correct concise self-generated solutions, then applies on-policy distillation with a concise self-teacher [5].
